messages.text: Hi, I sent back the bath mat I bought last month. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund eligibility and deadline for returned items, date window from purchase or delivery"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders", "title": "Which orders qualify", "text": "Only orders with the status \"delivered\" can receive a refund. An order that has not been delivered is not refunded through this process; if the customer reports a delivery that never arrived, a staff member takes the case. If a delivered order has no delivery time, or one that cannot be right (before the purchase or in the future), a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"h11-o1","unit_ids":["h11-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer requests a refund for the returned cotton bath mat."}

messages.name: propose_refund
messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-daf19e1087b548fb", "status": "ineligible", "outcome": "refused", "amount_minor": null, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": ["refund-policy/v1/window"], "next_step": "Tell the customer it cannot be refunded and why, citing the sections given."}

messages.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t refund the cotton bath mat because the request is outside the 30-day window from its recorded delivery date (refund-policy/v1/window).
It’s only a few hours past the deadline. Could you still make an exception?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"exceptions or discretion for refund request made after the 30-day deadline"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "Anything this policy does not cover, and any request for an exception, goes to a staff member. The customer can ask for a person at any time."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
